class.name: HEGoGraphAttributes
class.brief_description: Schema for a [HEGoGraphInput3D]: the attributes its points and connections can carry.
class.description: Parent this under a graph and fill [member attributes]. The list can be saved as its own scene and reused under other graphs. Several children concatenate in tree order.

members.member: Attribute definitions this child adds to its parent graph.

signal.name: schema_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the list of definitions, or a definition inside it, changes.
